posts.author: MisterX221
posts.body:
Howdy, i wanted to go back to learn rpg maker for a little practice project, and wanted to ask if there are some essential scripts to have, mostly for general project management and tweaks;
thanks.

posts.author: CloudTheWolf
posts.body:
Here are a few I can suggest:
Full Keyboard Input (By Cidiomar R. Dias Junior and maintained by Himeworks) -
https://himeworks.com/2013/07/full-input-keyboard/
Save to Appdata (by Jet) -
pastebin.com/KMK0RLkE
(Original Post:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/appdata-saving.12182/
but the link is broken there due to Paste Bin changes)
Basic Windows Resizer by V.M. of D.T. -
https://daimonioustails.weebly.com/basic-window-resizer.html
(Use the Paste Bin link)
OR
Fulezcreen++ by Zeus81 -
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/fullscreen.14081/
(You try and use both but you need to make tweaks to both scripts for them to play nice)
Battle Engine Symphony by Dr Yami -
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/battle-engine-symphony.6037/
If releasing on Steam:
Steamworks Achievements Integration by cyanic's -
https://github.com/GMMan/RGSS_SteamUserStatsLite
